{{Quote|Target spotted near Barracks D5. Engaging now.|A stormtrooper, talking about Starkiller|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Barracks D5''' was a barracks in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The barracks was built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]].<ref name="TFUII" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] late [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Galen Marek]], [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="TFUII" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II}}
During the escape, a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] reported that Starkiller was near Barracks D5 when Imperial forces were trying to stop the clone.<ref name="TFUII" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barracks D5 was first mentioned in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]]. The stormtrooper who reports Starkiller's presence varies each time the game is played, and may or may not mention Barracks D5 every time.<ref name="TFUII" />
